title: Chuloo/mural
why_read: A consumer language-learning app is a reasonable product but the listing offers little unique technical detail for an engineering audience.
analysis: This is a native iOS app for learning languages through conversation, built in Kotlin (likely using Kotlin Multiplatform for cross-platform native development). The tagline suggests a conversational, possibly AI-driven approach to language practice rather than traditional flashcard drilling. Without more architectural detail, it reads more as a product launch than a technical deep dive, though the choice of Kotlin for a native iPhone app is mildly interesting from a tooling perspective.
